     assert isinstance( w.sip, wcs.Sip )
     assert w.sip.crpix[0] == 2048
     assert w.sip.crpix[1] == 1026
+
+
+def test_zero_size_input():
+    """Test that zero-size input arrays are handled correctly."""
+    import numpy as np
+    
+    # Create a simple WCS object
+    w = wcs.WCS(naxis=2)
+    w.wcs.crpix = [1, 1]
+    w.wcs.cdelt = [1, 1]
+    w.wcs.crval = [0, 0]
+    w.wcs.ctype = ['RA---TAN', 'DEC--TAN']
+    
+    # Test with empty lists
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert len(result[0]) == 0
+    assert len(result[1]) == 0
+    
+    # Test with empty numpy arrays
+    result = w.wcs_pix2world(np.array([]), np.array([]), 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert len(result[0]) == 0
+    assert len(result[1]) == 0
+    
+    # Test with all_pix2world
+    result = w.all_pix2world([], [], 0)
+    assert len(result) == 2
+    assert len(result[0]) == 0
+    assert len(result[1]) == 0
